title: Prefill tests seed the exact values they assert — the A1/W5 prefill logic they claim to pin is never exercised
evidence:
pub fn substitute_trio_never_prefills_terminal_contact_test() {
  let objected =
    reference_call.ReferenceCallDetail(
      ..contact_row("rc-1", Objected),
      hooks: reference_call.ReferenceCallHooks(
        ..base_hooks(),
        can_substitute_referee: True,
      ),
    )
...
      edit: dict.from_list([
        #(
          "rc-1",
          model.RefcheckEdit(
            call_id: "rc-1",
            kind: model.RefcheckEditSubstitute,
            name: "",
            email: "",
            phone: "",
detail: Both tests seed the dict with the values they assert, so view_edit_trio's fallback prefill never runs; the fallback is dead anyway because the form renders only when a matching dict entry exists. W5/A1 prefill regressions pass uncaught.
recommended_fix: Drive UserChoseRefcheckAction/UserEditedRefcheckTrio via client.update (as refcheck_trio_editing_updates_live_values_test does) and assert the resulting values; or delete the dead fallback and pin prefill_refcheck_edit only.

title: Success-path test asserts surface-clearing against an already-clean fixture — only the toast count can fail
detail: Fixture has refcheck_edit dict.new(), confirm None, inflight empty, so the three clearing assertions can never fail; only the toast-count assertion bites. The r4 N1/N17 per-row clearing behavior the docstring claims is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Seed a pending edit/confirm/inflight for rc-1 plus a sibling row's edit (as the failure test does), then assert only rc-1's surfaces clear while the sibling's survive.

title: Save-validation tests drive UserSavedRefcheckEdit's unreachable no-entry branch, not the path the real Save button uses
detail: No dict entry is seeded, forcing the defensive prefill Error-branch; the Save button only renders when a matching entry exists, so the UI's live Ok-branch validation path stays unpinned.
recommended_fix: Seed the RefcheckEdit carrying the invalid values (like refcheck_save_resend_dispatches_test does) so the assertion covers the branch the real Save button drives.

title: All five dispatch tests assert only the inflight marker — a handler that never fires the endpoint still passes
detail: A handler that marks the row in-flight but returns effect.none(), or wires the wrong action name, slot, or body, passes every dispatch test. The endpoint-firing wiring is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Run the returned Effect with a capture dispatcher and assert ApiReturnedRefcheckAction is dispatched, or inject a mock api module and assert the endpoint, slot, and body args.

title: Em-dash scan pins unused consts while the actually-rendered correction state line is exempted — the W1 pin cannot fail on the live string
detail: refcheck_correction_heading/body are never rendered (the §8.3 state line replaced them, r4 N5), yet are scanned; refcheck_state_awaiting_correction — the string the correction surface actually renders — is exempted by construction.
recommended_fix: Remove or render the dead heading/body consts, and scan the rendered refcheck_state_awaiting_correction output (asserting dash-free) instead of exempting it.

title: API wire tests pin URLs only — the response decoder and POST bodies are untested
detail: action_result_decoder (absent reference_call_id must decode to "") and the correct/substitute JSON bodies are unpinned; a decoder regression turns every successful action into an error toast client-side.
recommended_fix: Add decoder tests for absent/null/string reference_call_id and assert the name/email/phone body keys for correct and substitute.
